gloss: urgently; immediately; as soon as possible

definitions.gloss: urgently; immediately; as soon as possible; without delay
definitions.explanation: With great urgency, indicating that something needs to be done right away.

examples.japanese: {早急|そうきゅう}に{対応|たいおう}してください。
この{問題|もんだい}は{早急|そうきゅう}に{解決|かいけつ}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: This problem needs to be resolved urgently.

examples.japanese: {被害|ひがい}が{拡大|かくだい}しないよう、{早急|そうきゅう}に{対策|たいさく}を{講|こう}じなければならない。
examples.english: We must take measures urgently to prevent the damage from spreading.

notes:
The adverbial form of {早急|そうきゅう} (urgent, pressing). The reading さっきゅう is also common and considered equally correct, though そうきゅう has become the more widely used pronunciation in modern Japanese. Frequently used in business, government, and formal contexts when swift action is required.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早急|そうきゅう}に{対応|たいおう}する: to respond urgently
- {早急|そうきゅう}に{解決|かいけつ}する: to resolve immediately
- {早急|そうきゅう}に{対策|たいさく}を{講|こう}じる: to take urgent measures
- {早急|そうきゅう}に{検討|けんとう}する: to examine immediately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {至急|しきゅう}: urgently — very similar but tends to appear in written requests and labels (e.g., {至急|しきゅう} on an envelope means "urgent")
- すぐに: immediately; right away — more casual and conversational
- {直|ただ}ちに: immediately; at once — formal, often used in official instructions or warnings
